clips.title: The story
paras: On Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, Melor Stonehoof sets hunters to difficult trials. He sends Horde hunters after dangerous beasts across the Barrens and Thousand Needles to test their tracking and mettle.

Melor Stonehoof watches the plains from Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. For the tauren, hunting joins survival with spiritual balance and respect for nature's greatest predators. Melor teaches those who carry bow and blade for the Horde to honor that balance, sending promising stalkers to test their craft against legendary beasts.

Melor sends hunters after elusive beasts that threaten the wilds. In the Barrens, they aid the huntress Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads, then pursue Steelsnap, a cunning and vicious hyena in Thousand Needles. These trials test whether hunters can outsmart and outfight the deadliest creatures of central Kalimdor.

Hunters who prove their skill in the Barrens face beasts in distant lands. Melor sends seasoned hunters after Deadmire, an ancient crocolisk in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh, and Frostmaw, a savage yeti in the Alterac Mountains. Each hunt tests whether a stalker has mastered the Hunter's Way.
